judge.name: unsloth-decision:unsloth-decision-4b

recipe.changes: none to the recipe; data revision pinned; provenance added

judge.base_load: hub id, main equal to the pinned revision
judge.parity_check: recipe evaluation on typed-decisions test within 0.02 of the recipe-reported accuracy and ECE
judge.reference_outputs_source: predict on the training notebook's example, recorded earlier in this session
judge.confidence_method: probability of the chosen option (yes/no: of the answer given) from the model's per-option probabilities
judge.native_confidence: predict's `confidence` field is P(chosen option) rounded to 4 decimals (score: P(most probable level)); kept in raw as native_confidence

ground_truth.label: human-annotated
ground_truth.meaning: real items labelled by one annotator; annotator error is part of the ground truth
purpose: pilot: token counts, throughput and variance before the pre-registration fixes n; never used to score a judge
caveats: translated parallel data, not native traffic; labels from SLURP annotation carried over by localisation
public since 2022: probably in the pretraining data of the judges audited

SLURP's utterances are requests to a home voice assistant collected for a research corpus, not production traffic; one intent label each, and MASSIVE publishes no inter-annotator agreement on the intent labels
en-US is the source language: SLURP's English utterances, from which the other locales were localised; it carries no localisation judgments
options: the 60 MASSIVE intent identifiers in alphabetical order, without definitions; instructions in criteria.language (en) whatever the locale of the text
230 distinct texts in 230 rows (case and whitespace ignored)
1 of the 60 intents never the label here (audio_volume_other), still an option

up to 4 dev utterances per intent, drawn with random.Random(2026) over intents in alphabetical order, the same items in every locale; drawn from dev, not train, so that a classifier fine-tuned on train never saw them; fewer in dev: audio_volume_other 0, cooking_query 2, general_greet 2, music_dislikeness 2
1 of 230 pilot texts also appear in the test split of the same locale (case and whitespace ignored), though no pilot item is a test item; _meta.text_in_test marks them

source.name: MASSIVE 1.1
source.citation: FitzGerald, Hench, Peris, Mackie, Rottmann, Sanchez, Nash, Urbach, Kakarala, Singh, Ranganath, Crist, Britan, Leeuwis, Tur & Natarajan 2023, MASSIVE: A 1M-Example Multilingual Natural Language Understanding Dataset with 51 Typologically-Diverse Languages, ACL 2023
source.derived_from: SLURP, CC BY 4.0: Bastianelli, Vanzo, Swietojanski & Rieser 2020, SLURP: A Spoken Language Understanding Resource Package, EMNLP 2020
